How to use Uplink Post Kit

This is my private publishing tool for Uplink. The page shows how it works; the same system is available as a service.

Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Each morning, open the queue on the phone.

2

Switch between the five views: Posts, Yap, Live, Saves, Playbook.

3

In Posts, filter by To post, To review, Posted or All, and open a card to see the slides or the video.

4

In Live, read the run sheet for the next session.

5

In Playbook, review the 42 moves taken from saved videos.

02

Features

01

Posts

The queue: scheduled time, series, slides or video, status, platform buttons and the posted mark.

STEPS

  1. Filter the queue
  2. Approve or request changes
  3. Post, then mark as posted
02

Yap

Daily talking-to-camera scripts with a hook, a story and a call to action.

STEPS

  1. Open today's script
  2. Film it
  3. Mark it done
03

Live

Run sheets for live sessions: preparation, timed segments, what to say, pinned comment, follow-up.

STEPS

  1. Choose the session
  2. Follow the timed segments
  3. Complete the after-live list
04

Saves and Playbook

Saved videos summarized into lessons and ideas, and a playbook built from them.

STEPS

  1. Browse the saves
  2. Read the lesson
  3. Try one move per week
03Tips
  • One idea per post.
  • Review on the phone you post from.
  • The posted mark is the only record needed.
04FAQ
Can I get this for my brand?

Yes, as a service. See Content systems on the services page.

Why is there no link?

It is a private tool. The screenshots and the guided tour show how it works.

Where do the posts go?

TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook, through the phone's share sheet.

How many posts per day?

Up to 20 carousels and 5 videos.
